Coram : RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI*, N.V. RAMANA
NEGOTIABLE INSTRUMENTS ACT, 1881: A B s. 138 (b) - 'Notice' - Court's power to condone delay in c filing a complaint uls 138 - Dishonour of cheque ..:.. Hand written note sent by complainant to accused calling upon him to make the payment - Subsequently a formal legal notice issued by complainant issued within the mandatory period of thirty days of dishonour 0 of cheques and fulfilled the mandatory requirements under clause (b) of proviso to s. 138 - Therefore, High Court committed no error in considering the handwritten note as 'notice' u/s 138. s.142(b}, proviso r/w s.138 - Condonation
Decision Date : 11-08-2014 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1684/2014 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
